name: pi-lean-dimension
description: Bundles pi-lean-portal, pi-lean-search, and pi-lean-host: web browsing on Chromium or Firefox, extendable with any Playwright-based stealth backend, keyless SearXNG search, and REST API recipes with OAuth and local secrets. /web and /api toggles.
